name: delegate
description: Hand tasks to Codex or Antigravity as Claude Code subagents, with the conversation's own permissions.

codexSandbox.title: Codex sandbox
codexSandbox.description: off runs Codex without its sandbox when the conversation is in accept-edits or auto mode, for work a sandbox stops, such as adb, an emulator or a build that writes outside the repository. Codex then runs commands without asking. Plan, default and dontAsk mode keep the sandbox.
